# When --use-receiver-type names a type that does not define a called method,
# generate notes the inferred signature so the untyped fallback is visible
# where it originates instead of surfacing later as check errors on any.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
cmp stdout want-out.txt

exec go vet .

-- want-out.txt --
note: T does not define ListPages(ctx context.Context) any; the generated RoutesReceiver declares this inferred signature — implement the method to type-check the template against real types
-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET / ListPages(ctx)" -}}ok{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))
